description: This file defines the CommandResolver enum with static methods for resolving command paths, managing project root, handling SSH targets, and constructing command-line invocations for the openclaw application, including remote execution via SSH.

classes.name: CommandResolver
classes.description: Enum providing static methods for command resolution, project root management, SSH target parsing, and command construction for the openclaw application.

methods.name: gatewayEntrypoint
methods.description: Determines the entry point script for the gateway, checking for specific files in the project root.

methods.name: runtimeResolution
methods.description: Resolves the runtime environment, optionally with specified search paths.

methods.name: makeRuntimeCommand
methods.description: Constructs a command array to run a specific runtime with given entrypoint and subcommand.

methods.name: runtimeErrorCommand
methods.description: Generates a command array to output a runtime resolution error message.

methods.name: errorCommand
methods.description: Creates a shell script command to output an error message and exit.

methods.name: projectRoot
methods.description: Determines the project root directory, using stored preferences or fallback paths.

methods.name: setProjectRoot
methods.description: Stores a new project root path in user defaults.

methods.name: projectRootPath
methods.description: Returns the current project root path as a string.

methods.name: preferredPaths
methods.description: Generates a list of preferred executable search paths, including project-specific and system paths.

methods.name: openclawManagedPaths
methods.description: Returns paths managed by openclaw, such as local bin directories.

methods.name: nodeManagerBinPaths
methods.description: Returns paths for various Node.js version managers.

methods.name: versionedNodeBinPaths
methods.description: Lists paths for specific Node.js versions based on directory contents.

methods.name: findExecutable
methods.description: Searches for an executable by name within given search paths.

methods.name: openclawExecutable
methods.description: Finds the openclaw CLI executable in search paths.

methods.name: projectOpenClawExecutable
methods.description: Returns the project-specific openclaw executable path if available.

methods.name: nodeCliPath
methods.description: Returns the path to the node CLI script if readable.

methods.name: hasAnyOpenClawInvoker
methods.description: Checks if any openclaw invoker (CLI or node) is available.

methods.name: openclawNodeCommand
methods.description: Constructs the command to invoke openclaw via Node.js, possibly remotely via SSH.

methods.name: openclawCommand
methods.description: Alias for openclawNodeCommand, for convenience.

methods.name: sshNodeCommand
methods.description: Constructs an SSH command to run openclaw on a remote host.

methods.name: connectionSettings
methods.description: Retrieves remote connection settings from defaults and config.

methods.name: connectionModeIsRemote
methods.description: Checks if the current connection mode is remote.

methods.name: sanitizedTarget
methods.description: Sanitizes SSH target string by trimming and removing 'ssh ' prefix.

methods.name: parseSSHTarget
methods.description: Parses an SSH target string into user, host, and port components.

methods.name: sshTargetValidationMessage
methods.description: Provides validation message for SSH target string.

methods.name: shellQuote
methods.description: Quotes a string for safe inclusion in shell commands.

methods.name: expandPath
methods.description: Expands a path string, replacing '~' with home directory.

methods.name: normalizeSSHTargetInput
methods.description: Normalizes SSH target input string.

methods.name: isValidSSHComponent
methods.description: Validates SSH component strings.

methods.name: makeSSHTarget
methods.description: Creates an SSHParsedTarget object if components are valid.

methods.name: sshTargetString
methods.description: Constructs SSH target string from components.

methods.name: sshArguments
methods.description: Builds SSH command line arguments from target, identity, options, and remote command.
